columns.label: EPA/play
columns.title: Overall offensive efficiency — EPA per play, garbage time excluded. The default ranking.

columns.label: Succ%
columns.title: Success rate — share of plays with positive EPA.

columns.label: O-Line
columns.title: Offensive line index — pass protection (sack + pressure rate taken, inverted) blended with run blocking (yards before contact). 50 = league average, +10 per standard deviation.

columns.label: Pass EPA
columns.title: EPA per pass play.

columns.label: Comp%
columns.title: Team completion percentage.

columns.label: Pass Rtg
columns.title: NFL passer rating from team passing totals (closest stand-in for QBR the data carries).

columns.label: Pass Y/G
columns.title: Passing yards per game.

columns.label: Sack%
columns.title: Sacks taken per dropback — lower is better protection.

columns.label: Rush EPA
columns.title: EPA per rush.

columns.label: Rush Y/G
columns.title: Rushing yards per game.

columns.label: YBC/Att
columns.title: Rushing yards before contact per carry (PFR charting, 2018+) — the run-blocking half of line play.

columns.label: Yds/Rec
columns.title: Receiving yards per catch — depth/YAC of the receiving game.

columns.label: Expl%
columns.title: Explosive play rate (big gains per play).

columns.label: 3rd%
columns.title: Third-down conversion rate.

columns.label: RZ TD%
columns.title: Red-zone touchdown rate — trips inside the 20 that ended in a touchdown (garbage time excluded). Finishing: the engine's touchdown split reads it.

columns.label: RZ EPA
columns.title: EPA per play on snaps inside the opponent's 20.

columns.label: Field EPA
columns.title: EPA per play on every other snap — moving the ball between the 20s. High here with a low RZ TD% is yards without touchdowns.

columns.label: Pts/G
columns.title: Points scored per game.

columns.label: Giv/G
columns.title: Giveaways per game — interceptions thrown plus fumbles lost.

columns.label: Flags/G
columns.title: Accepted penalties per game committed by the offense (special teams flags on its possessions included, garbage time excluded).

columns.label: Pre-snap/G
columns.title: Pre-snap flags per game — false starts, delay of game, formation, shift, motion, too many men. Barely persists within a season — a tendency at most.

columns.label: DPI Yds/G
columns.title: Defensive pass interference yards drawn per game — free yards that never show as passing yards.

columns.label: EPA/play
columns.title: Overall defensive efficiency — EPA per play allowed, garbage time excluded. Lower is better; the default ranking.

columns.label: Succ%
columns.title: Success rate allowed — share of opponent plays with positive EPA.

columns.label: Pass EPA
columns.title: EPA per pass play allowed.

columns.label: Comp%
columns.title: Completion percentage allowed.

columns.label: Pass Rtg
columns.title: Passer rating allowed to opposing quarterbacks.

columns.label: Pass Y/G
columns.title: Passing yards allowed per game.

columns.label: Sack%
columns.title: Sacks made per opponent dropback — the pass rush.

columns.label: Press%
columns.title: Pressure rate (sack or QB hit) per opponent dropback.

columns.label: Rush EPA
columns.title: EPA per rush allowed.

columns.label: Rush Y/G
columns.title: Rushing yards allowed per game.

columns.label: YBC/Att
columns.title: Yards before contact allowed per carry — how quickly the front seven meets the runner.

columns.label: Expl%
columns.title: Explosive play rate allowed.

columns.label: 3rd Stop%
columns.title: Third-down stop rate — opponent conversions prevented.

columns.label: RZ TD%
columns.title: Red-zone touchdown rate allowed — opponent trips inside the 20 that ended in a touchdown. Lower = holds them to field goals.

columns.label: RZ EPA
columns.title: EPA per play allowed on snaps inside its own 20.

columns.label: Field EPA
columns.title: EPA per play allowed on every other snap. High here with a low RZ TD% allowed is bend-don't-break.

columns.label: PA/G
columns.title: Points allowed per game.

columns.label: Take/G
columns.title: Takeaways per game — interceptions plus fumble recoveries.

columns.label: Flags/G
columns.title: Accepted penalties per game committed by the defense — free first downs for the other offense.

columns.label: Pre-snap/G
columns.title: Pre-snap flags per game — offside, neutral zone, encroachment, too many men. The one penalty rate that persists at all, and only faintly.

columns.label: DPI Yds/G
columns.title: Defensive pass interference yards committed per game.

columns.title: Share of designed runs that go left

columns.label: Left YPC
columns.title: Yards per carry running left

columns.label: Left SR
columns.title: Success rate (EPA > 0) running left

columns.title: Share of designed runs that go middle

columns.label: Middle YPC
columns.title: Yards per carry running middle

columns.label: Middle SR
columns.title: Success rate (EPA > 0) running middle

columns.label: Right %
columns.title: Share of designed runs that go right

columns.label: Right YPC
columns.title: Yards per carry running right

columns.label: Right SR
columns.title: Success rate (EPA > 0) running right

columns.label: Left %
columns.title: Share of runs faced that come left

columns.title: Yards per carry allowed on runs left

columns.label: Left SR
columns.title: Success rate allowed on runs left

columns.title: Share of runs faced that come middle

columns.label: Middle SR
columns.title: Success rate allowed on runs middle
